title: RAMESES
subtitle: THE NIGHT OF DEPARTURE
intro: THE GATES OPEN. A PEOPLE SETS OUT.
CLEAR THE COURTYARDS AND LEAVE EGYPT.
outro: THE CITY FALLS QUIET BEHIND YOU.
THE CARAVAN GATHERS AT SUCCOTH.

title: SUCCOTH
subtitle: THE FIRST ENCAMPMENT
intro: TENTS RISE AT THE EDGE OF THE FIELDS.
HOLD THE CAMP UNTIL THE ROAD IS CLEAR.
outro: THE FIRES ARE DOUSED. THE CAMP MOVES.
A PILLAR LEADS TOWARD THE WATER.

title: PI-HAHIROTH
subtitle: THE SEA CROSSING
intro: WATER RISES ON EITHER SIDE.
DEFEND THE PASSAGE THROUGH THE SEA.
outro: THE LAST TRAVELERS REACH DRY GROUND.
THE WILDERNESS OPENS BEFORE YOU.

title: MARAH
subtitle: BITTER WATER
intro: THE FIRST SPRING OFFERS NO RELIEF.
CLEAR ITS BANKS AND SECURE THE WATER.
outro: THE SPRING BECOMES A PLACE TO REST.
PALMS PROMISE SHELTER FARTHER SOUTH.

title: ELIM
subtitle: TWELVE SPRINGS
intro: PALMS SHADE A RING OF CLEAR SPRINGS.
GUARD THE OASIS WHILE THE CAMP RESTS.
outro: WATERSKINS ARE FILLED FOR THE ROAD.
THE STONE LEDGES OF DOPHKAH WAIT.

title: DOPHKAH
subtitle: THE STONE ROAD
intro: THE ROAD WINDS THROUGH A STONE QUARRY.
CLEAR THE LEDGES FOR THE CARAVAN.
outro: THE QUARRY FALLS SILENT BEHIND YOU.
THE ROCKY PASS OF REPHIDIM LIES AHEAD.

title: REPHIDIM
subtitle: THE ROCKY PASS
intro: THE NARROW VALLEY ECHOES WITH DANGER.
HOLD THE HIGH GROUND ABOVE THE CAMP.
outro: THE PASS IS OPEN. THE PEOPLE ADVANCE.
A GREAT MOUNTAIN RISES THROUGH CLOUD.

title: MOUNT SINAI
subtitle: FIRE ON THE MOUNTAIN
intro: THUNDER ROLLS ABOVE THE STONE ALTAR.
KEEP THE MOUNTAIN APPROACH SAFE.
outro: THE CAMP GATHERS BELOW THE SUMMIT.
THE NEXT ROAD LEADS INTO WILDERNESS.

title: SINAI WILDERNESS
subtitle: THE WANDERING ROAD
intro: DUNES AND RIDGES HIDE THE WAY AHEAD.
OPEN A ROUTE THROUGH THE WILDERNESS.
outro: THE SCOUTS FIND A PATH BETWEEN RIDGES.
WATCH FIRES MARK THE NEXT CAMPS.

title: WILDERNESS CAMPS
subtitle: FIRES ALONG THE ROAD
intro: SMALL FIRES MARK A LONG NIGHT ROAD.
HOLD THE CAMP THROUGH THREE ATTACKS.
outro: THE WATCH FIRES SURVIVE THE NIGHT.
THE CARAVAN TURNS TOWARD EZION-GEBER.

title: EZION-GEBER
subtitle: AT THE HEAD OF THE GULF
intro: MASTS RISE WHERE THE DESERT MEETS SEA.
SECURE THE DOCKS AND THE NORTH ROAD.
outro: THE GULF SHIMMERS BEHIND THE CAMP.
THE ROAD TURNS NORTHWEST TO KADESH.

title: KADESH
subtitle: YEARS IN THE DESERT
intro: A GENERATION WAITS AMONG THE CLIFFS.
SECURE THE CAVES BEFORE MOVING ON.
outro: AT LAST THE CAMP TURNS EASTWARD.
THE LONG DETOUR AROUND EDOM BEGINS.

title: AROUND EDOM
subtitle: THE EASTERN WILDERNESS
intro: THE DIRECT PASSAGE REMAINS CLOSED.
FIND A WAY AROUND THE RED MOUNTAINS.
outro: THE EASTERN PASS OPENS TO THE NORTH.
MOAB RISES ABOVE THE DISTANT VALLEY.

title: PLAINS OF MOAB
subtitle: ACROSS THE VALLEY
intro: CANAAN CAN BE SEEN ACROSS THE RIVER.
CLEAR THE HEIGHTS AND PREPARE TO CROSS.
outro: THE RIVER VALLEY LIES FAR BELOW.
THE SUMMIT OF NEBO REVEALS THE WAY.

title: MOUNT NEBO
subtitle: THE LAND BEYOND
intro: GREEN HILLS APPEAR ACROSS THE VALLEY.
KEEP THE SUMMIT APPROACH CLEAR.
outro: FROM THE HEIGHTS THE ROAD IS VISIBLE.
JOSHUA LEADS ON TOWARD THE JORDAN.

title: JORDAN CROSSING
subtitle: THE FAR BANK
intro: THE RIVER ROAD OPENS BEFORE THE CAMP.
GUARD THE CROSSING INTO CANAAN.
outro: THE PEOPLE GATHER ON THE WESTERN BANK.
THE WALLS OF JERICHO STAND AHEAD.

title: JERICHO
subtitle: THE GATES OF CANAAN
intro: THE JOURNEY REACHES THE ANCIENT WALLS.
CLEAR THE GATES AND OPEN THE HILL ROAD.
outro: THE GATES OPEN. THE PEOPLE ADVANCE.
ONE LAST ROAD CLIMBS TO THE HILLS OF AI.

title: AI
subtitle: THE HILL COUNTRY
intro: THE ROAD CLIMBS ABOVE THE RIVER PLAIN.
OVERCOME THE LAST HILL-FORT DEFENDERS.
outro: THE FINAL HEIGHTS ARE QUIET AT LAST.
FROM EGYPT TO CANAAN - JOURNEY COMPLETE.
